title: Format page
description: Lathe's record format: how records are kept, then an index of the kinds by stage, the relations and the checks by severity.

title: Kind page
description: What the reference says about one kind, its columns included, in the workbench, with the kind's facts in the side bar.

title: Check page
description: One check's severity, explanation, query and the problems it reports now, in the workbench, with the check's facts in the side bar.

title: Checks page
description: A space's Checks page: every problem of its product, errors first, grouped by check, then the workspace's under Workspace.

title: Product page
description: The product's one page, at its ID: its description, its domains as cards with coverage bars (designed, built and proved) and tests by state, its summary of what Lathe counts across it, its open questions and its problems, with its facts, children and links both ways in the side bar.

title: Workbench
description: The app's frame around every page: the stage behind it, the floating panels over it (the navigation, the tab panel with the page bar and the header strip, the wiki card and the side bar), tooltips, the keys and the announcer, and on a phone the top bar, the drawers and the sheets.

title: Appearance page
description: The mode choice, every theme with a preview, import and export, and the editor for a theme of one's own.

title: Theme picker
description: The Color theme and Light, dark or system quick picks, which preview as they are arrowed.

title: Command palette
description: Every command that applies, with its keys, filtered as the Reader types.

title: Shortcuts sheet
description: Every shortcut grouped as Navigate, View, Graph and Lists, with a search and the override note.

title: Native menus
description: The desktop app's menu bar: the app menu, File, Edit, View, Window and Help.

title: Desktop title bar
description: The app's own 38 px bar in the desktop window: back and forward, the command center and the layout toggles.

title: Launch view
description: The shell color, the logo and "Opening <product>…" until the page has its specs.

title: Error page
description: The engine's message, with Retry, Open Another Folder and Reveal in Finder.

title: About window
description: The app's, the engine's and Electron's versions, with links to the repo and the record format.

title: Dock icon
description: Lathe's icon in the Dock, with its badge and its menu.

title: Nav
description: The left menu: with two or more products, a rail with one icon per product (each product a space), and a panel listing the current space's domains with their capabilities, headed by its name and icon. It holds quick find and the stage folders.

title: Domain page
description: The domain's one page, at its ID: its description, its records grouped by stage, a search box, and the domain's coverage (designed, built and proved), gaps and problems, with its facts, children and links both ways in the side bar.

title: Record page
description: One record: its text fields rendered as Markdown, its part rows and other fields, parent and children, links out and in grouped by relation, and its problems.

title: Graph stage
description: The whole model as one map, shown on the Graph stage of an address and focused on that record (or a group of the graph's tree, at its address): laid out left to right in columns by depth in the parent/child tree, like a folder tree, every parent as tall as its children and every sibling in one column, children grouped by kind, each kind drawn in its own shape (a domain a hexagon). The camera frames the focus and the levels the depth asks for in the open space the floating panels leave; a toolbar floating at the top of that space holds the layout and depth switches, the Links switch, the steps and the kind and relation filters, with a minimap and the camera's buttons at its corners.

title: ERD stage
description: The entity-relationship diagram of a domain (each aggregate a boundary around its entities), of an aggregate, or of an entity's aggregate with the entity picked out, on the stage behind the floating panels and fitted in the open space they leave, with a key floating at its foot. It draws entities and their relationships only.

title: Side bar
description: The page's last column, with its Details, Outline and History views, beside every page.

title: Focus page
description: One full-window stage, the Graph, the ERD or the Trace, switched in the page bar and named in the address, with everything else floating over it as frosted panels: the nav, the tab panel (the page bar with its tabs, then the header strip naming the focus), the wiki card with the focus's wiki page, and the side bar. The stage frames the focus in the open space the panels leave.

title: Products page
description: The space chooser at `/`: every product, with its look and its number of domains.

title: Trace stage
description: What an address owes and how far it has come, drawn on the canvas with the graph's renderer, camera and pointer: on an obligation its chain left to right, why it is there (the business outcomes its capability serves, the capability, the use case) and then what designs it, builds it, proves it and the files they name, an arrow for each actual link; on a record or group with obligations under it a "why" tree on the left and one lane per obligation on the right, every gap a dashed empty box in its column and the Untraced records in a lane of their own. It is framed in the open space. The table of the same chains is its accessible layer, visually hidden under the canvas, and the whole stage on a phone.
